answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 32795 Country: India Title: Abortion of 2-3 week pregnancy. Question: Alhamdulillah I got married recently and my wife is 2 weeks pregnant. we are staying alone and not in joint family. We are mentally not prepared for a child right now. We are also planning to go for Hajj next year insha-Allah, which has become Fard upon me. Is it lawful to do an abortion at this stage based on above issues? Please advice. Answer ID: 32795 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 963/804/B=1432) It is not any reasonable Shariah excuse not to get ready for the child rights. Hence, it is not lawful to abort the pregnancy without a valid reason. Nikah is meant for procreation and reproduction and you are not happy with it mentally nor ready for it. This feeling of yours is not a religious one. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
